root_cause: GestureCallbacks had no secondary or tertiary tap or long-press callbacks, and button masks never reached the tree's pointer dispatch (frame.rs only admitted primary presses to gesture dispatch, and interaction.rs passed button 0).
change: incular-gestures/src/details.rs: PointerButtonClass, ButtonGestureCallbacks, GestureCallbacks::secondary/tertiary and for_button_class (a press keeps only its own button's callbacks). incular-widgets/src/tree/interaction.rs: dispatch_pointer_gesture_with_hit_buttons; the button class selects callbacks; primary-only pans, delayed and immediate drags, the scroll chain and inner-button tap yield are skipped for non-primary presses. incular-runtime/src/frame.rs (outside ownership): passes buttons and admits secondary/tertiary Down and Up to gesture dispatch. incular-widgets/src/gestures.rs: 22 builders (on_secondary_*, on_tertiary_*).
tests: crates/incular-gestures/tests/button_taps.rs (button masks, secondary/tertiary routing, no drag join, secondary long press at deadline)
harness: no scenario: FrameHarness cannot send a right-click (audit harness request).
api_change: additive: new GestureCallbacks fields secondary, tertiary, on_tap_move, on_long_press_down, on_long_press_cancel; new builders; new re-exports. Struct literals using ..Default are unaffected.
limitations: A chord with primary is treated as primary. Back and forward buttons take no part. Secondary drags are not modelled (Flutter has none by default). The tree test calls dispatch_pointer_gesture_with_hit_buttons directly, so the runtime gate change in frame.rs is covered only by compile and existing runtime tests.

root_cause: Three sub-findings: onTapMove, onLongPressDown and onLongPressCancel were absent from the recognizer and builders; ForcePressGestureRecognizer is not wired into the tree.
change: Fixed portion: incular-gestures/src/pointer.rs tap move on each move of a pending press; long-press down at the press; long-press cancel when a press that reported down loses before its long press starts (release, cancel, or movement beyond slop, which also rejects the long press as Flutter does). Builders on_tap_move, on_long_press_down, on_long_press_cancel. Deferred portion: force press (crates/incular-gestures/src/force_press.rs) is still unwired. It needs an arena member kind analogous to scale, pressure from RawPointerEvent.sample.pressure, and the onForcePress* builders.
harness: none (no scenario for tap move, long-press down or force press)
api_change: additive: on_tap_move, on_long_press_down, on_long_press_cancel builders and fields; TapMoveDetails and LongPressDownDetails types
limitations: Force press not implemented. Tap move fires on every pending move, including moves past slop before rejection; Flutter's tracking after rejection was not confirmed against source.
note: Behaviour change: movement beyond hit slop before the deadline now rejects the long press, as Flutter's LongPressGestureRecognizer does. Existing long-press tests still pass.

root_cause: DragDropContext::feedback() stored the feedback snapshot but nothing painted it; the module note left presentation to the app.
change: incular-widgets/src/drag_drop.rs From<Draggable>: while a feedback builder is set, the child is wrapped in a stateful OverlayPortal (root_overlay, shown while context.feedback() is Some). Its overlay layout places IgnorePointer(feedback) at feedback.position through Positioned. DragSourceBinding::update bumps the shared revision when the position changes, so the overlay follows the pointer.
harness: gestures__draggable_drop_target: see the harness result in the report; the recorder does not probe feedback, so the feedback itself is not in the trace. Pixel harness not run.
api_change: none (behaviour: the framework presents feedback when a feedback builder is set).
limitations: The overlay is a root overlay, so the feedback loses inherited ancestors such as Directionality: a Text feedback under a tree with only an ancestor Directionality fails layout (the tests use box feedback for this reason). feedback_offset is not applied to the painted position, matching Flutter, which uses it only for hit testing. The transient role is the default popover.
note: Verified by transient surface presence before and after the drag.

root_cause: DragTargetBinding::enter returned false without storing rejecting targets, and drag_target_ancestor returned only the nearest DragTarget, so rejected targets got no onMove or onLeave and nested targets did not fall through.
change: incular-widgets/src/tree/interaction.rs: drag_target_ancestors (all targets from the hit element outward); update_drag_target follows Flutter updateDrag (listsMatch prefix check; enter innermost-first until one accepts; update and leave for every entered target); finish_drag drops on the accepting target, then leaves the other entered targets; cancel leaves all. incular-widgets/src/tree.rs (outside ownership): ActiveDrag gains an entered list; target keeps the accepting target.
harness: gestures__draggable_drop_target: see the harness result in the report (single-target scene). Nested scene harness request not added.
limitations: The path is the ancestor chain of the hit element, not every render object under the pointer, so overlapping siblings are not in the path.
note: onLeave now fires for rejecting targets at drop, as Flutter's _leaveAllEntered does.

root_cause: DragTarget::new took only a child, so the child could not depend on candidate or rejected payloads.
change: incular-widgets/src/drag_drop.rs: DragTarget::builder(context, Fn(Vec<T>, Vec<T>) -> Widget). DragTargetHover holds the candidate and rejected lists; enter, leave and drop update them and bump a revision that rebuilds the child, the same mechanism as child_when_dragging.
limitations: Payloads are typed T, not dynamic as in Flutter. The shared state is one payload per context, so the lists hold at most one entry.

root_cause: Dismissible forward and reverse flings used forward_on_next_tick or reverse_on_next_tick, so the slide took movement_duration whatever the release velocity.
change: incular-widgets/src/dismissible.rs drag_end: flings call fling_on_next_tick with the release velocity times FLING_VELOCITY_SCALE (1/300, Flutter _kFlingVelocityScale), negated for reverse. Module doc updated.
tests: crates/incular-widgets/tests/dismissible.rs::a_faster_fling_dismisses_sooner_than_a_slower_one (24 px per 10 ms against 12 px per 10 ms)
harness: no scenario for fling duration; sample_list_fling and gestures__dismissible_threshold are not rerun in this pass.
limitations: The fling uses Incular's fling spring, not a frame-by-frame comparison with Flutter's _kFlingSpringDescription curve.
note: A first draft test used speeds too close to kMinFlingVelocity: the velocity estimate fell below it and the drag reversed. The test now uses speeds well above it.

root_cause: InteractiveViewer lacked trackpadScrollCausesScale. Its pointer_signal also scaled on every scroll signal, including trackpad signals, so the default differed from Flutter, which ignores trackpad scroll unless the flag is set.
change: incular-widgets/src/interactive_viewer.rs: trackpad_scroll_causes_scale builder (default false); pointer_signal ignores Trackpad-kind signals unless the flag is set. DeviceGestureSettings slop overrides not added.
harness: gestures__interactive_viewer_mouse_wheel_zoom unaffected (mouse). No regression test: scroll_at has no device kind, so a trackpad signal cannot be produced by the widget test helper.
limitations: DeviceGestureSettings (MediaQuery gesture settings) has no Incular counterpart, so its slop overrides are deferred. The trackpad branch relies on the platform adapter reporting Trackpad kind on scroll signals, which was not verified on hardware.
note: Deferred because half of the finding (DeviceGestureSettings) is not implemented.

root_cause: Flutter's weightedEvent and weightedContinuous are per-gesture axis locks (_evaluateLockedAxis, lockedAxis reset at drag end). Incular's Weighted is a stateless per-update attenuation and matches neither.
api_change: none yet; splitting the enum is a public API change
limitations: Needs lock state in the two-dimensional controller that persists across updates and resets at gesture end. Larger than this pass.
note: Which Flutter mode Weighted most resembles was not established; it is closest to neither.
